newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Council of Europe raises Navigator to 6.5 bln esc.
newsitem.headline: Council of Europe raises Navigator to 6.5 bln esc.

text.p: The Social Development Fund of the Council of Europe has decided to raise to 6.5 billion escudos from five billion its 10-year Navigator announced recently, said Banco Santander de Negocios Portugal, leader of the operation.
The issue is indexed to six-month Lisbor plus 40 basis points when the rate is below eight percent. When the rate exceeds eight percent, the issue is indexed to 16.4 percent minus six-month Lisbor.
The coupon has a floor of four percent and the liquidation date is expected to be July 7, 1997.
